name: Dave McCormick
stance: Warns that state-by-state AI regulation would stifle innovation and has questioned the decision to allow advanced Nvidia chip exports to China.

statements.text: If the government starts to regulate state by state and everything else, we're going to kill this unbelievable innovation that's happening.
I don't think there is an anti-regulatory sentiment in the Congress or in the administration,

Said at the Aspen Security Forum that he was concerned about the administration letting Nvidia sell its H200 chips in China, warning that selling its most advanced chips would boost China's AI capabilities.
